choose.when: AND refund_order_id IS NOT NULL AND refunded_amount = 0
AND refund_order_id IS NOT NULL AND refunded_amount > 0 AND pay_amount > 0 AND refunded_amount >= pay_amount
AND refund_order_id IS NOT NULL AND refunded_amount > 0 AND pay_amount > 0 AND refunded_amount < pay_amount
AND refund_order_id IS NULL AND refund_application_status = 'PENDING_MERCHANT'
AND refund_order_id IS NULL AND (refund_application_status IS NULL OR refund_application_status <> 'PENDING_MERCHANT') AND aftersale_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','WAITING_SUPPLEMENT')
choose.otherwise: AND refund_order_id IS NULL AND (refund_application_status IS NULL OR refund_application_status <> 'PENDING_MERCHANT') AND (aftersale_status IS NULL OR aftersale_status NOT IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','WAITING_SUPPLEMENT')) AND order_stage = #{displayStatus}

mapper.sql: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, merchant_id, store_id, service_id, reservation_id, order_stage, payment_status, verification_status, refund_application_status, aftersale_status, refund_order_id, original_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, refunded_amount, appointment_start_at, appointment_end_at, paid_at, confirmed_at, verified_at, canceled_at, cancel_reason, payment_expire_at, reschedule_count, version FROM pet_order
